about:
# <cy>PRNTSCRN</c>

<c-AAAAAA>*(Pronounced  `print screen` , or your native language's translation)*</c>\
A screenshot tool inspired by Minecraft's F2 key!\
<c-e0e0e0>By</c> <c-009d9d>Ray</c><c-00ffff>Dee</c><c-009d9d>Ux</c><c-e0e0e0>,</c> <c-00ff00>nin</c><c-2222ff>X</c><c-00ff00>out</c><c-e0e0e0>,</c> <c-ff6666>mat</c><c-e0e0e0>,</c> <c-7d7dff>Prev</c><c-ffa040>ter</c><c-e0e0e0>, and</c> <c-fcb5ff>hiim</c><c-00c8ff>jasmine</c><c-fcb5ff>00</c><c-e0e0e0><c-e0e0e0>.</c>

Tired of that clunky three-key screenshot hotkey? Don't like the window shadows in macOS's windowed screenshots? Scrambling to hide items in DevTools to take the perfect screenshot? Disappointed by the low-resolution pictures from Steam's screenshotting options?

Let <cy>PRNTSCRN</c> make the screenshotting process easier for you!

## Features
- <c-ff9a00>Screenshot levels</c> with options to <cy>hide</c> <cl>your UI</c>, <co>your</c> <cj>player</c><c-AAAAAA>\*</c>, <cf>the attempt label</c>, <cg>Practice Mode checkpoints</c>, and even other players<c-AAAAAA>\*</c> from <c-f0d47f>Globed</c> or <c-fe45ad>C</c><c-ff59b1>h</c><c-ff6888>a</c><c-fd8874>m</c><c-fd9660>p</c><c-fdaf4f>i</c><c-ffc03c>o</c><c-fed125>n</c><c-ffe220>s</c>!
- <c-ff9a00>Automate level screenshots</c> in percentage or seconds intervals!
- <c-ff9a00>Customizable dimensions</c> for screenshots!<c-999999>\*\*</c>
- <c-ff9a00>An API</c> for other mods to take screenshots through this mod!
- <c-40a2f5>Eclipse Menu</c> and <c-ff7462>QOL</c><c-ff7462>Mod</c> integration!
- <cs>Rebindable</c> keybinds!
- <cs>Save as JPG</c>! (macOS/Windows only. All devices support PNG.)
- <cs>Copy to clipboard</c>! (macOS/Windows only. <c-ff5555>Might break in Wine.</c>)

## Special Thanks
- <c-ff6666>mat</c> for the original RenderTexture implementation (licensed under the MIT License) and mod idea; without it, none of this would've been possible.
- <c-00ff00>nin</c><c-2222ff>X</c><c-00ff00>out</c> for fleshing out this mod even further while he still could, and adding macOS support.
- <c-7d7dff>Prev</c><c-ffa040>ter</c> for help in writing the API for this mod, fixing Windows image clipboard copying, refactoring some code, and generously lending his C++ expertise and his [ImagePlus API](mod:prevter.imageplus) to make iOS/Android support possible.
- <c-fcb5ff>hiim</c><c-00c8ff>jasmine</c><c-fcb5ff>00</c> for fixing iOS support.
- <c-ff4444>CatXus</c> for beta-testing Android support.
- <c-4c6e5d>Alp</c><c-73ab90>ha</c><c-bc419c>la</c><c-ce6087>n</c><c-ec9667>e</c><c-fcfc78>o</c><c-83da96>u</c><c-80d5dc>s</c>, <c-fcb5ff>hiim</c><c-00c8ff>jasmine</c><c-fcb5ff>00</c>, <c-7d00ff>Firee</c>, and <c-b680ff>slideglide</c> for beta-testing iOS support.
- <c-777777>Brift</c> for designing the camera sprite (and by extension, the mod logo).

### Memorial for those who gave up partway

- <c-ff7d00>Tech</c><c-ffb900>Student</c><c-ff7d00>10</c> (o7)
- <c-49457c>k</c><c-51477a>m</c><c-5a4b79>7</c><c-634d78>d</c><c-6d5076>e</c><c-765475>v</c> (o7)

### Notes

- <c-AAAAAA>\**Not all parts of your player (or players from multiplayer mods) can be easily hidden, including player ghost trails, dash fire sprites, and spider teleport effects. To hide these effects more consistently during gameplay, see the featuresets in Eclipse Menu or KrazyPlayLayer.*</c>
- <c-999999>\*\**For best results (or if you just hate crashes in general), please use a conventional aspect ratio (16:9, 16:10, 4:3, etc.) for your game window sizes.*</c>

This [Geode mod](https://geode-sdk.org) is licensed under LGPLv2. [Join RayDeeUx's Discord server](https://discord.gg/WqZBYdBWZW) to report issues with using the mod.
changelog:
# <cy>PRNTSCRN</c> Changelog
## v1.0.15
- Fix very stupid and avoidable crashes.
## v1.0.14
- Added a primitive screenshot gallery.
  - This is not available through mod menu integrations at this time.
- Hide some other nodes during screenshots.
- Fix a very stupid and avoidable crash.
## v1.0.13
- Improved compatibility with SDL mod.
- Added QOLMod integration.
- Fixed an issue with the GRAVE keybind not being set properly for first-time installs.
## v1.0.12
- Added a new option to hide Geode's Overlay Manager when taking screenshots.
  - This setting only hides Geode's Overlay Manager when taking screenshots of what's on the screen itself (and not when screenshotting a specific level or the level editor).
  - This setting is disabled by default to preserve past behavior.
- Added LevelPath's player trail to the "Hide Playtest Path + Clicks" filter toggle.
  - This mod is not yet on the index as of publishing this update, but will be available soon.
- Fixed a really blatant typo in one of the mod setting descriptions.
## v1.0.11
<c-aaaaaa>*Disclaimer: For a number of reasons (especially legal), any sub-bullet points referring to Update 2.2081 in this changelog represents RayDeeUx's (Erymanthus') opinions on Update 2.2081, and no one else's.*</c>
- Fix that darn bug where scrollable layers would be partially cropped out in screenshots taken by PRNTSCRN itself.
  - This bug would've been noticed and fixed sooner if the source code changes for Update 2.2081 had been written by humans instead of being held together by duct tape.
  - There were also some smaller changes within Geode v5 itself that caused this issue, one of which hadn't been passed along to me until later.
  - Point being: my decision to not update to Geode v5 and GD 2.2081 on my own machine came back to bite me (as seen with the bug this update aims to fix), and I probably should've fixed this sooner despite these circumstances.
  - Thanks to Prevter for the bugfix!
## v1.0.10 and v1.0.9
- Restore Eclipse Menu integration.
  - That's the whole update.
## v1.0.8
- Port to Geode v5.0.0-beta.3 and GD 2.2081.
- Temporarily remove Eclipse Menu integration.
- Added a new option to hide Noclip Tints from most major mod menus during screenshot.
  - This is to compensate for a few node IDs this mod claimed to filter, only to never actually do anything to them.
  - These options might also prove useful in a number of niche scenarios not worth discussing here.
- Added nodes from Difficulty Progression and MegaHack v9 to the "Hide UI" filter toggle.
  - These changes are not going away any time soon, and if anything, should've been added as early as v1.0.5.
- Added the dummy trail from Editor Trail In-Game to the "Hide Player" filter toggle.
  - The editor trail added by this mod is tied to the player.
- Automatically hide the grayscale shader from GrayscaleMode by default.
  - Originally, you had to hide the grayscale shader on your own if you were to take a screenshot inside a level.
## v1.0.7
- Fix some UI problems. Sorry about that!
## v1.0.6
- Added options to hide the editor grid, editor playtest path, and editor object hitboxes.
  - These options were inspired by <c-ff007d>Au</c><c-fffa7f>sk</c>.
## v1.0.5
- Minor bugfixes related to the API. Hopefully.
## v1.0.4
- Minor bugfixes related to the API. Hopefully.
## v1.0.3
- Consistently hide checkpoint objects.
## v1.0.2
- Consistently hide UI elements.
## v1.0.1
- Added detection for texture quality changes.
## v1.0.0
- Initial release (on GitHub).
